and awarded less/ meager amount of compensation than the market value,
(b) for issuance of an appropriate writ(s), order(s), direction(s) or a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding upon the respondents to pay the fair/ adequate compensation to the petitioner with regard to acquisition of his land for- construction of National Highway-75 (SEC-V), when other land loosers namely Rajendra Pratap Dev & others whose land (agricultural/rural) situated at Village/
Mouza-- Narkhoria Kala (adjacent/near village) was also acquired for the same purpose has received highest rate i.e. Rs.2,76,080/- (Annexure- 6) for per decimal which is highest rate in comparison to another land looser including the petitioner.
3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission with withdraw the present writ petition with a liberty to work out his remedy in accordance with law.
4. Learned counsels for the respondents have no objection.
6. Accordingly, the present writ petition is, hereby, disposed of with the aforesaid liberty.
7. Pending interlocutory application, if any, also stands disposed of.
